title: Plane Spotter: watch Kai Tak from the car park roof
dek: No flying needed: pick a viewpoint, watch the traffic and use the sim clock to see the whole day.
description: Plane Spotter in Fly Kai Tak: watch arrivals, departures and pushbacks from the car park roof, with zoom, time controls, a live map and the flight board.
hero_alt: The view from the car park roof rail: the terminal roof below, the apron and the runway beyond, and Hong Kong Island across the harbour.
hero_caption: From the car park roof: over the terminal to the apron, the runway and the harbour.

zh.title: 飛機迷模式：喺停車場天台睇啟德
zh.dek: 唔使駕駛：揀個觀景點，睇住飛機嚟嚟去去，再用模擬器時鐘睇齊成日。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 嘅飛機迷模式：喺停車場天台睇飛機升降同推機，有放大、時間控制、即時地圖同航班資訊板。
zh.hero_alt: 喺停車場天台欄杆望出去：下面係客運大樓屋頂，遠處係停機坪同跑道，海港對面係香港島。
zh.hero_caption: 喺停車場天台：越過客運大樓望向停機坪、跑道同海港。
